title: Tesla Optimus robot is now doing real factory work

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Tesla's Optimus is a game-changer—it's the first humanoid robot to perform real factory tasks at scale. This is the future of manufacturing.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Optimus is still in early stages, relying on outdated neural networks and limited dexterity. It's not ready for complex, high-speed factory environments.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Tesla's Full Self-Driving protocol enables Optimus to adapt in real time. It’s trained on billions of miles of data, giving it unmatched precision.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even with that data, Optimus can’t handle high-temperature environments or precision assembly—core factory needs it can’t meet.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Optimus will evolve. Tesla’s commitment to AI and robotics ensures it’ll dominate the industry—this is just the beginning.
